title: JustEhannn/clickr-ai
summary: Free, open-source AI copilot for your Mac. Ask about your screen and let Agent Mode do tasks, powered by a local model through Ollama.

title: CrispStrobe/CrispSorter
summary: AI-powered document organiser. Extracts text and/or sorts documents: Drop in a bunch of PDFs, DOCX files, or ebooks, and it extracts Document Text, identifies Title, Author, and Year, with a local or remote LLM, and moves them into folders, and/or keeps the extracted text.

title: LeeGyeongPil/ai-lab-llm-gateway
summary: Hands-on demo: call OpenAI-style, Anthropic, Gemini and local Ollama models through one interface, swap models by config, and try retry, fallback and routing. Logs tokens, cost and latency per call. Runs in mock mode without keys.

title: LeeGyeongPil/ai-lab-llm-eval-gate
summary: Tiny dependency-free LLM prompt eval gate: scores prompts on a small test set (incl. LLM judge) and fails CI on regressions beyond a noise range. Offline demo via recorded answers.

title: LeeGyeongPil/ai-lab-agent-loop-mcp
summary: See an AI agent loop step by step: thoughts, MCP tool calls and results on a live timeline. Runs with a mock model or local Ollama. Beginner-friendly guide.

title: EstaxNet/Inferpal
summary: Local AI coding agent for Visual Studio 2026/2022, VS Code, and Zed, JetBrains & Neovim via ACP. Your own model (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI-compatible), no account, no telemetry. Attaches a real debugger to fix failing tests.

title: LeeGyeongPil/ai-lab-local-llm-bench
summary: Dependency-free Python tool that benchmarks a local Ollama server and splits latency into queue, load, prefill and decode. Try it keyless with a mock mode that replays recorded timings. M1: input length and concurrency.

title: mathieuballotma-sketch/Beaume-
summary: Prototype d’assistant juridique local pour avocats : analyse de dossiers, traçabilité et recherche de textes de loi. Fiabilité juridique en cours d’évaluation.

title: marcodemm/artificial-intelligence-for-burp-suite-xagentai-net
summary: Burp Suite extension that brings six AI providers (Claude, OpenAI, NVIDIA, LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp) into the right-click workflow — Analyze with AI, Send to Repeater / Intruder with one click. Apache-2.0.

title: AlacrityAgency/Flux
summary: Open-source Agentic Software Engineering Engine — Tree-sitter RepoMap, Plan/Act mode, self-healing compiler/test loops, surgical edits, shadow Git checkpoints & isolated parallel worktrees (Apache-2.0).

title: MouseWurX/Bob
summary: Bob: a local AI agent with a personality. Tools, 256K+ context, code, research, pictures and voice, plus an AI Lab to cut and test models and his own llama.cpp engine that switches experts live, can turn them on or off to test cuts before you make them, can intelligently divide experts, merge models, and more! On your PC, Mac, Linux, or phone.

title: drew-codes-things/starfire.ai
summary: A terminal-themed local AI chat interface powered by Ollama, collecting all of your downloaded models into one spot

title: drew-codes-things/ArtyCode
summary: Arty CLI: a terminal coding agent that runs on your own Arty brain

title: radmirooch/claro
summary: Local real-time speech captions and translation for macOS: Qwen3-ASR / Whisper.cpp + Ollama, no cloud, no npm dependencies

title: Ronan-Wood/substrate
summary: A local search engine for Markdown vaults: composes vaults into scopes, indexes them, and serves search over a CLI and an MCP server. Local models only.

title: agentforgehu/thymos-engine
summary: Thymos (心潮): a local-first, inspectable engine coupling forgetting curves, appraisal-based affect, endocrine modulation and environment.

title: jcommaret/kodia
summary: An Opensource alternative to Cursor

title: Nano-Collective/nanocoder
summary: An open coding agent for your terminal, built by a community collective rather than a company. Bring your own model, keep your code on your machine, and owe nothing to anyone.

title: nace-ai/kapitsa
summary: Blazing fast Apple Silicon inference engine optimized for Qwen & Nemotron. OpenAI + Anthropic API compatible. Built by folks from nace.ai

title: antiv/mate
summary: Production-ready multi-agent orchestration engine built on Google ADK. Database-driven agent config, 50+ LLM providers, MCP protocol, persistent memory, web dashboard, RBAC.
